units.title: Check that a recognised LICENSE file exists
units.acceptance: Returns pass for MIT/Apache-2.0/GPL files and fail when no license is present.

units.title: Check that README explains the project
units.acceptance: Returns pass when README has a title, installation and usage sections.

units.title: Check that CONTRIBUTING describes the pull-request workflow
units.acceptance: Returns pass when CONTRIBUTING mentions pull requests and tests.

units.title: Check that a code of conduct is adopted
units.acceptance: Returns pass when CODE_OF_CONDUCT references Contributor Covenant or an equivalent policy.

units.title: Check that SECURITY explains vulnerability reporting
units.acceptance: Returns pass when SECURITY describes a private reporting channel.

units.title: Check that a CI workflow runs on push and pull request
units.acceptance: Returns pass when a workflow declares both triggers and at least one job.

units.title: Check that CODEOWNERS assigns ownership
units.acceptance: Returns pass when CODEOWNERS contains at least one rule with an owner.

units.title: Check that Dependabot is configured
units.acceptance: Returns pass when dependabot.yml declares a package ecosystem.

units.title: Check that issue templates exist
units.acceptance: Returns pass when .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE contains at least one template.

units.title: Check that branch protection is documented
units.acceptance: Returns pass when .github/branch-protection.yml documents the policy; API verification is out of scope for local checks.
